title: Draw component events only from the owning feature's ioSeeds

facts.note: Planning task mentions a component's events or dependencies, or a feature's ioSeeds.
Planning artifacts carrying component consume/produce/dependency lists and feature ioSeeds.

values: component consume/produce list added or edited
feature ioSeeds added, edited or removed
facts.note: Needs a diff-level observer over component event/dependency lists and the owning feature's ioSeeds.

values: declared component event not in owning feature's ioSeeds
more than 3 consumed or more than 3 produced events
dependency neither same-feature component nor external
facts.note: Needs a checker that resolves the owning feature and compares sets; implementation.type is none in the source.

values: declared event not relevant to component role (consume) or capability (produce)
facts.note: Whether an event matches the component's role or capability is a semantic judgement; no deterministic relation exists in the source.

fires: Planner declares a component that produces an event absent from the owning feature's ioSeeds.produce.
Planner adds a consumed event to a component that the feature's ioSeeds.consume does not list.
Planner changes a feature's ioSeeds so an existing component's declared events are no longer a subset.
Planner gives a component a consumed event unrelated to its role, or a produced event unrelated to its capability.
Planner lists a fourth consumed or a fourth produced event on one component.
Planner adds a component dependency on a component of another feature that is not an external dependency.
doesNotFire: A component that declares no consumed or produced events AND whose dependencies are all same-feature components or external dependencies. (Empty event lists alone only satisfy the event-subset part; dependency sourcing must still be checked.)
Authoring a feature's ioSeeds before any component of that feature declares events or dependencies.
Code-level changes that do not touch planning artifacts.

given: A component belonging to a feature declares consumed or produced events, or dependencies
when: the planner authors, edits or reviews those events or dependencies, or changes the feature's ioSeeds
then: Every declared consumed event must come from feature.ioSeeds.consume and fit the component's role, and every declared produced event from feature.ioSeeds.produce and fit its capability, so all events are a subset of, and traceable to, a feature ioSeed.
prefer: Need a new event? Add it to the feature's ioSeeds first, then reference it.
Pick only the ioSeeds events the component's role actually consumes / its capability actually produces; the filter selects, it does not force inclusion of every seed.
avoid: Inventing inputs/outputs the feature never declared (e.g. producing an event absent from ioSeeds.produce).
Events not selected by the role (consume) or capability (produce) filter.
More than 3 consumed or 3 produced events per component.
Dependencies other than same-feature components or external dependencies.
why: Limiting component events to the feature's ioSeeds keeps each component's interface within its feature's declared contract, so no component invents inputs or outputs the feature never promised.
evidence: For each component, set(consumes) ⊆ owning feature.ioSeeds.consume and set(produces) ⊆ owning feature.ioSeeds.produce.
Each consumed event is justified by the component's role and each produced event by its capability (filtered from the respective ioSeeds list); reviewer states the role/capability link per event.
Each component lists at most 3 consumed and at most 3 produced events.
Compliant example: component consumes [dilemma:presented] where feature.ioSeeds.consume includes dilemma:presented.
Violation example: component produces order:shipped but feature.ioSeeds.produce does not contain it.
Component dependencies come from other components in the same feature plus external dependencies.
verifier_detail: Term events_subset ('Events subset of feature ioSeeds'): rule = component events must be a subset of feature ioSeeds; check = all consumed/produced events traceable to feature ioSeeds.

Term event_limits ('Consume/produce limits and sources'): consumes.source = feature.ioSeeds.consume filtered by component role, maximum 3, example [dilemma:presented, user:authenticated]; produces.source = feature.ioSeeds.produce filtered by component capability, maximum 3, example [decision:made, validation:completed].
Term dependencies ('Component dependencies'): source = other components in same feature + external dependencies; example ids: component:same:feature.other, wagon:external#io.
No automated implementation exists (implementation.type: none); check is reviewer/LLM-judged until an observer is built.

Subset check is per declared event: if the owning feature's ioSeeds list for a direction is absent or empty, any declared event in that direction is untraceable and is a finding; a component with no declared events in that direction produces no event-subset finding, but its dependencies are still checked against the dependency-source rule. The source requires no minimum number of events.

additions.text: The 3-event cap and dependency sourcing are independent obligations; they remain mandatory here via avoid[2]/avoid[3], evidence and activation, and are also proposed as planner.component.io-limits and planner.component.dependency-sources.
